_comment: Retrieval gold set for hyptest.pdf. Questions are written in the register students
actually use — lowercase, imprecise, sometimes asking for the thing by description
rather than by name — because that is what the retriever will see in production.
'expect' lists EVERY chunk that would be an acceptable top hit. Several questions
have more than one defensible answer (the 2x2 table and the Type I Error section
both answer 'what is a type I error'), and scoring them as single-answer would
'expect': [] marks a NEGATIVE — the document does not contain the answer. Its title
promises Analysis of Variance but the notes end at Cohen's d, so ANOVA questions are
free, honest negatives. They measure the behaviour that matters most in a grounded
tutor: saying the material does not cover something instead of inventing it.
'lang': de questions probe cross-lingual retrieval against English source.
